item.text: {"case_id":"SHC086","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C02","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both proclamations follow the same distinctive safeguard structure: a USITC affirmative injury determination and remedy recommendations; a presidential determination to provide relief; relief framed as additional duties lasting roughly three years with rates reduced in later years; invocation of section 604 authority; modification of subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTS through an annex; and nearly identical effectiveness, duration, and supersession clauses. C02 and C23 share much of this machinery, but C22 is strongest because its remedy is an annually declining additional duty rather than principally a tariff-rate quota or a mixed package of safeguards.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The USITC commissioners voting in the affirmative under section 421(b) of the Trade Act also transmitted to me their recommendations ... on proposed remedies that ... would be necessary to remedy the market disruption","parent_excerpt":"The USITC also transmitted to the President its recommendations made pursuant to section 202(e) ... with respect to the action that would address the serious injury or threat thereof","explanation":"Both use the commission's affirmative determination and remedy recommendations as the predicate for presidential safeguard relief."},{"child_excerpt":"Such import relief shall take the form of an additional duty ... imposed for a period of 3 years. For the first year ... 35 percent ... For the second year ... 30 percent ... and in the third year ... 25 percent","parent_excerpt":"Such action shall take the form of an increase in duty ... imposed for a period of 3 years plus 1 day ... with annual reductions in the rate of duty in the second and third years","explanation":"This is the central shared remedial design: a multiyear additional import duty with declining annual rates."},{"child_excerpt":"In order to apply additional duties ... subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTS is modified as provided in the Annex to this proclamation.","parent_excerpt":"In order to establish an increase in duty ... subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTS is modified as provided in the Annex to this proclamation.","explanation":"The operative implementation clause is materially parallel, adapting the same HTS chapter-and-annex machinery to a different product and country."},{"child_excerpt":"The modifications to the HTS made by this proclamation, including the Annex thereto, shall be effective with respect to goods entered, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption ... and shall continue in effect ... unless such actions are earlier expressly modified or terminated.","parent_excerpt":"The modifications to the HTS made by this proclamation, including the Annex hereto, shall be effective with respect to goods entered, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption ... and shall continue in effect ... unless such actions are earlier expressly modified or terminated.","explanation":"The near-verbatim effectiveness and duration clause reinforces that the later proclamation reused the earlier safeguard-proclamation form."}]}
